answer: This question appears to contain a false premise. Based on my knowledge through February 2025, no European Union member states left the bloc in 2024. The only EU member state to have left the European Union was the United Kingdom, which departed on January 31, 2020 (Brexit). While various EU member states have experienced political tensions or discussions about their relationship with the EU in recent years, none have actually withdrawn their membership. I cannot identify two member states that left in 2024 because I am not aware of any such departures occurring.
